svg.title: hive: a lead plans, spawns workers, and is woken when they finish
svg.desc: A terminal window. A lead session writes a plan pad and three todos, spawns three worker sessions with a todo each, sets a wake, and is woken as each worker finishes. Ends with three todos checked and 3/3 done.

g.text: What would you like to work on next?
Top of the board: auth tests
